late_press_handling: Presses after deadline are retained and right-censored at the fixed analytic horizon; only missing-RT or anticipatory press trials are excluded.
empirical_belief_construction: Instructed and empirical cue representations are computed on the complete pre-filter trial sequence. Likelihood-specific RT exclusions and horizon censoring therefore do not remove preceding cue/target observations from the strictly lagged empirical update.
strict_outer_fold_definition: For each RL outer fold, both train and test latent trajectories were generated from that fold's train-only RL posterior. DDM parameters were fitted on outer-train subjects and evaluated only on untouched outer-test subjects.
public_path_normalization_note: Nonportable absolute paths from the executed run were replaced by public package-relative or controlled-input references; numerical settings/results are unchanged.
